newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish industry invested 14% more in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Swedish industry invested 14% more in 1996.

text.p: Investment by Swedish industry increased 14 percent, to 65 billion crowns in 1996 compared to the year before, Statistics Sweden said in a statement on Tuesday.
It said that companies planned to invest 66 billion crowns in 1997.
Investments in the transport industry increased by 50 percent in 1996 and the sector plans a 10 percent increase in 1997, Statistics Sweden said. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017
